topic: Accessing the analytics interface translation system
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed a client's inability to locate or access the analytics interface translation system. [me] provided the link (https://i18n.allunite.com/) and noted that another team member had previously closed registration for it.

It was determined that confirmation is needed regarding the current status of the system's registration. If it is closed, a temporary opening must be requested for the client.
decisions: Confirm if the analytics interface translation system is currently registered/open.
action_items: Follow up with the relevant team member (Толя) to confirm the registration status of i18n.allunite.com.
If closed, request a temporary opening for the client access.
